subject.title: improve: reduce GPT-5.6 coding harness overhead

question: Should this security-sensitive, cross-surface QA and Codex containment change proceed as one PR after the failing checks and direct Codex sandbox-contract review are resolved?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label, sandbox-boundary change, and repository-specific direct-Codex review rule require an owner to judge the intended containment scope rather than treating green unit coverage or the supplied hosted transcript as sufficient alone.

options.title: Finish scoped validation and merge
options.body: Resolve or explain the two failed checks, refresh the branch on current main, and confirm the private-QA gate preserves ordinary Codex sandbox behavior.

options.title: Split the QA reporting work
options.body: Land prompt/reporting improvements separately if the Codex sandbox contract review needs a slower security-focused path.

recommendation.title: Finish scoped validation and merge
recommendation.body: Resolve or explain the two failed checks, refresh the branch on current main, and confirm the private-QA gate preserves ordinary Codex sandbox behavior.
